quote: I checked all 120 files in `migrations/` with an AST scan instead of a regex.
context: I checked all 120 files in `migrations/` with an AST scan instead of a regex. The scan flags any `execute`, `executemany` or `executescript` call whose first argument isn't a plain string literal, so it also catches SQL that is built up in steps. Six calls were flagged. Every other flagged call was `executescript(DDL)` or `executescript(SCHEMA)` with a constant, which is safe.
method: AST scan of all migration files and grep for aliased execute calls
